title: authoring gate: an app navigation `visible` with a CEL syntax error passes save, draft diagnostics and publish (a page `visibleWhen` with the same fault is refused), and page variables publish with duplicate, empty or wrong-typed declarations
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filed by the PM seat for the W3-RT runner `session_017xRBcRX4wwwVw5bEckffdp`, whose own write was refused by its session permissions (RUNNER rule 2: staged text, posted verbatim through the same door).

QA-source: #28656 · studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

1. **App nav `visible` with a CEL syntax error is admitted.** `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/APP?mode=draft&package=PKG` with `navigation[0].visible = "'org_owner' in"` → 200. The draft read shows `_diagnostics {"valid":true}`, and `POST /api/v1/packages/PKG/publish-drafts` → `published`. At runtime the entry is withheld from every viewer (it fails closed), and the console logs `[parse] Unexpected token: EOF`. So the author gets no signal; the entry silently disappears for everyone.
   - **Contrast:** the same fault in a page `visibleWhen` is caught. Draft diagnostics report `visibility-predicate-syntax`, and publish is refused `INVALID_METADATA`.
2. **Page variable declarations are not validated** (observed from the `studio-authoring.authored-page-slots-and-variables` probe). Each of these publishes with `valid:true`:
   - duplicate variable names;
   - an empty variable name;
   - a `number` variable with `defaultValue: "abc"`;
   - a block `source` naming a component that does not exist;
   - a `visibleWhen` reading an undeclared `page.nosuch`.

**Expected:** the author-time gate refuses (or at minimum reports in draft `_diagnostics`) a predicate that does not parse on every surface that carries one, nav `visible` included, and refuses page variables that are duplicated, unnamed or whose default does not match their type.

Measured at framework `6e11a929` (main, 2026-11-01), on a stock showcase boot with scratch packages installed at runtime.

## Reproduction

1. As admin, install a scratch package PKG (`POST /api/v1/packages`) with an object and an app APP.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/APP?mode=draft&package=PKG` with a `navigation` entry whose `visible` is `"'org_owner' in"` → 200. `GET` the draft → `_diagnostics.valid: true`. Publish → `published`.
3. Open the app in the console as admin (who holds `org_owner`): the entry is absent, and the console log has `[parse] Unexpected token: EOF`.
4. Contrast: `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/PAGE?mode=draft&package=PKG` with a block `visibleWhen` that does not parse → draft `_diagnostics` names `visibility-predicate-syntax`; publish → refused `INVALID_METADATA`.

## Mechanism (suspected)

The runtime authoring gate (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts` and `protocol-authoring-gate.ts`) runs the predicate-syntax rule over page `visibleWhen` but not over app `navigation[].visible` or `areas[].navigation[].visible`. Page `variables` have no rule for uniqueness, non-empty names or default-versus-type.

Related: #27457 (closed) made the console evaluate bare-string nav predicates as CEL; this card is the author-time half.
